question: Each vowel in the word MUNDANE is changed to the letter immediately following it in the English alphabetical order. Which of the following letters will be the third from the right in the new group of letters thus formed?
solution:
According to the given information,

 
• Each vowel in the word MUNDANE is changed to the letter immediately following it in the English alphabetical order.
 
• The word will become → **MVNDBNF.**
 
• **The third letter from the right is B.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/20531450b93234d479218b3a661a5d1637660957dd4d95ac59049488a40862ed.png] **​**

**​**Hence, the correct answer is "B".
